column3: Show Va'xug's Eye of Kilrogg the way back to the main Ashenvale road.
column4:
Show my Eye of Kilrogg the way out of this ravine and back to the Ashenvale road. Keep it moving and I'll follow once I see a clear path.

I'll stay here--one of us should keep our bearings. If you lose the way, I can guide you back through the eye. I will not have us both wandering blind in this malicious forest.

I can hold the channel for four minutes. No longer. Reach the road before the vision breaks, or return to me and we try again.

column3: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.
column4: The ancient Gurubashi of Stranglethorn Vale were da masters of dark blood magics. Rumors be they'd use pure truesilver idols to channel that bad bad voodoo.\r\n\r\nOl' Mazu'kon would love to get his hands on one of those idols... for academics ya see. How 'bout you gather some friends and do a bit of smash and grab on that drowned city stickin' out the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn? Kill the most impressive lookin' priest ya can find in there, and they sure to have what I be lookin' for.

column3: Acquire 6 Acidic Venom Sacs for Do'gol in Brackenwall Village.
column4: Hmmm, there's writing right here on the rim of the shield, but it's hard to read from all the burned stuff.$b$bI need acid to make it clear. Venom from the Darkfang spiders in the marsh would do good. Get me some of their sacs and I can clean this up.

column3: Speak with Brom Killian in Undercity to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
column4: Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.\r\n\r\nI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.

column3: Collect $1oa Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.
column4:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.

column3: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the Barrens.
column4: I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.\r\n\r\nThe big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.

column3: Give the Raptor Talon Amulet to Gor'mul.
column4: Here, take this amulet to Gor'mul, and see if the raptors' strength can awaken the flame of the warrior that once burned through his veins.

column3: Speak with Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos to learn to become a cook.
column4: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.\r\n\r\nCooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

column3: Acquire $1oa Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.
column4: I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.\r\n\r\nI believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.

column3: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Young Panthers.
column4: If you want to be a part of the hunt with this crack group Hemet has assembled, you're going to need to prove yourself an able panther hunter.  We'll start you out easy -- don't you worry.  Let's see you kill 10 young panthers to start.$b$bTracking them down is only half the challenge...
